runners.comment: Back in prime form when scoring at Plumpton this month and now 4-10 over hurdles

runners.spotlight: Back in prime form when scoring in first-time tongue-tie at Plumpton (2m4f, good to soft; front pair clear) a fortnight ago and now 4-10 over hurdles; recent 4lb rise does not look excessive and he should be fine on the faster ground here; likely contender.

runners.spotlight: Did well for new stable in early part of season, winning three times (2m2f-3m, good/good to soft); absent since below-par run in the autumn but can play a significant role if fully tuned up.

runners.spotlight: Well beaten on handicap debut in January but last month's keeping-on third at Taunton (2m3f, heavy) was much better and further progress is possible if the much faster ground here suits.

runners.comment: Ran well for a long way on handicap debut; can feature if today's faster ground suits

runners.spotlight: Sprung a 40-1 surprise on his stable debut at Southwell (6f) in November; held in three runs since but those were all creditable efforts including a close third at Southwell last month; had wind surgery since and he's respected off only 1lb higher than last time.

runners.breeder: Mme Isabelle Mauger & Mr Guy Benachour
runners.comment: Record of 5-12 on AW but he was disappointing at Kempton last time; needs to bounce back
runners.name: Dyrholaey
runners.spotlight: Made it 5-11 on AW when landing a Class 4 handicap at Chelmsford (6f, Polytrack) last month; only 2lb higher here but he's not easy to predict and needs to bounce back after a disappointing run at Kempton last time.

runners.comment: Completed an eight-timer at Southwell (1m) last month but he's been vulnerable since
runners.name: Aisling Oscar
runners.spotlight: Completed his remarkable eight-timer at Southwell (1m) last month but he's comes up short since and looked tapped for speed when dropped back to 6f at Newcastle 11 days ago; that wasn't a bad effort but he's never won over this trip and others looker stronger.

runners.comment: On reduced mark and he ran well on his reappearance over C&D last month; in the mix
runners.name: The Flying Seagull
runners.owner: Two Plus Three Two Plus Four
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-14 but he's on a reduced mark and returned after 233 days off with a creditable fourth over C&D last month; should benefit from that run and it wouldn't be a surprise if he made a bold bid.

runners.comment: Just one win from 14 starts and she faded on stable debut at Southwell last month
runners.name: Glamour Show
runners.spotlight: 1-13 for Eve Johnson Houghton, the win coming in a Kempton novice (6f, Polytrack) last March; reappeared with a respectable effort on her stable debut at Southwell last month but she needs to build on that and this is her first run at this track.

runners.comment: Seven wins since December and he completed a four-timer at Newcastle latest; big player
runners.name: Yorkshire Glory
runners.spotlight: Has won seven of his last ten starts and he completed a four-timer at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) 11 days ago; 5lb higher on this big step up in grade but he dug deep to repel the closers last time and he could continue on the upgrade; key player.
